overview: BLIP-based VQA student for SelTDA on A-OKVQA.
usage:
## Load locally

```bash
python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=1 train_vqa.py \
  --config configs/aokvqa.yaml \
  --overrides pretrained=<path-to-checkpoint.pth> wandb=false
```

Each Kaggle version maps to one `.pth` (see version notes).
